body: Large language model (LLM) inference is often constrained by both computation and memory, especially in offloading-based deployments where model weights are transferred across memory hierarchies during autoregressive decoding. In this setting, reducing the number of executed layers can lower per-token latency while also avoiding costly weight movement. Motivated by this observation, we present FlexEE, an early exiting framework for resource-constrained and offloading-based LLM inference. FlexEE makes early exiting practical for LLM decoding through layer-wise exit supervision for reliable intermediate-layer prediction, self-speculative decoding over a Top-K local vocabulary for low-cost exit decisions, and dynamic hidden state management for KV-cache-correct and memory-aware execution. Across generative and downstream tasks, FlexEE enables efficient early exit with minimal accuracy degradation, delivering up to 1.27×/3.16× and 1.25×/2.83× end-to-end speedups on Llama2-7B and Llama3-8B under 0%/50% weight offloading, respectively.
summaryZh: 针对资源受限及权重卸载场景下的LLM推理瓶颈，本文提出了FlexEE早期退出框架。该框架通过层级退出监督、基于Top-K词表的自推测解码以及动态KV缓存管理，实现了在保持精度的同时显著降低推理延迟。实验表明，在Llama系列模型上，FlexEE在不同卸载比例下均实现了显著的端到端加速，为边缘计算及内存受限环境下的模型部署提供了高效解决方案。

aiReview.reasonZh: FlexEE框架通过创新的早期退出机制显著提升了资源受限环境下的推理速度，具有很高的工程实用价值。

glossary.explanationZh: 早期退出，指在模型推理过程中，根据中间层输出提前终止计算以节省资源的技术。
权重卸载，指将模型权重从GPU显存移动到内存或磁盘以应对显存不足的技术。
自回归解码，大模型生成文本的标准方式，即逐个生成Token。
键值缓存，用于存储模型中间计算结果以加速后续Token生成的缓存机制。
